mentions.name: Shepherd TBR app
mentions.description: A personal book diary described as 'Notion, but for books'. It lets readers collect and smart-sort their to-be-read lists, log their reads, and uses that data to build a 'book dna' profile that connects them with new books and authors loved by readers with matching tastes ('book twins').
mentions.audience: Readers who maintain to-be-read piles and want personalized book and author recommendations
mentions.source_excerpt: We are working to build Notion, but for books. It is a personal book diary to collect your to-be-read and smart sort them, as well as log your reads and use that data to build a profile of your book dna in order to connect you with new books/authors that your book twins love.
